_comment: Each step of the application modernization kit, with the NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls whose statements it supports, other federal requirements, and the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators it aligns to. Control names are from NIST's OSCAL catalog, release 5.2.0. Every control-to-KSI pair is one the workbook's other kits already use, read from fedramp.gov's 2026 KSI pages (CM-3(2) and CM-4(2) to KSI-CMT-VTD; CM-2 to KSI-SVC-ACM; CM-3 to KSI-CMT-LMC; AC-6 to KSI-IAM-ELP; AU-2 and AU-12 to KSI-MLA-LET; AC-2 to KSI-IAM-AAM; CM-8 to KSI-PIY-GIV; SC-7 to KSI-CNA-MAT; CA-7 to KSI-MLA-EVC; AU-9 to KSI-MLA-OSM; IA-5 to KSI-IAM-SNU). The WP rows follow Book 18, Appendix A's requirements table. KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with them and doesn't report KSIs itself. Which step supports which control is the program's reading (design guidance); the agency's assessor decides.
